notes: meaneth is read as the linking verb standing where the copula would stand, joining the interrogative predicate (rule 20), as in 1SA.4.6.

qol ha-tse'aqah has an arthrous rectum, so the article keeps the the before its own word and the construct takes a supplied one; in qol he-hamon ha-zeh the one written determiner is the demonstrative's and both articles go unrepresented (rules 29, 41 and 47).
The le before Eli is unrepresented because the ASV writes a bare object (rule 40).
